A state is complete only after its necessary physical operations are verified

measurement_definitions.config_churn: Count actual physical additions/removals/replacements; compare to frozen rule set differences. Ownership changes are not physical operations.
measurement_definitions.adaptation_latency: Duration from start of processing an actionable/withdrawal-eligible update until independently verified physical realization; record clock source and timepoints.
measurement_definitions.grace_delay: Track first vs second non-actionable observations separately from processing latency.
measurement_definitions.deduplication: No more than one effective domain configuration rule per enforcing Squid proxy while A/B coexist.
measurement_definitions.stale_rule: Temporarily managed rule that remains physically after verified eligible last-owner withdrawal.
measurement_definitions.premature_withdrawal: Rule absent physically while a current valid owner still requires it.
measurement_definitions.idempotence: No new physical operations and unchanged effective physical configuration after S8.
